# Marcos Merino Sánchez - Portfolio & Professional Summary

## About Marcos
Marcos Merino Sánchez is a Software Developer experienced in web and mobile applications, RESTful APIs, relational database architecture (MySQL, Microsoft SQL Server, DB2), ETL data integration pipelines, and Business Intelligence dashboards (Qlik Sense, Power BI).
